layman_headline: Solana trade is working — up 4.3% — but the rest of the market offers slim pickings right now.
layman_explanation: Our Solana position is performing well, up about 4.3% from where we bought it, and it's been one of the strongest movers this week with an 11.6% weekly gain. The broader crypto market is in a 'Greed' phase with Bitcoin dominance at 59%, which means Bitcoin is sucking attention away from smaller coins. The swing trade candidates today are mostly stablecoins, heavily beaten-down tokens, or coins with no clear technical setup — none offer a compelling risk/reward entry right now.
layman_action: Hold the Solana position and let it run toward the $115 target. Keep the stop-loss at $92. Don't chase new trades in this environment — wait for a clearer setup.
expert_reasoning: The current swing candidates are exceptionally weak. RLUSD, FDUSD, and USDG are stablecoins with no swing potential. MON is down 6.7% weekly and 45% from ATH with zero technical data available. JTO has dropped 18.2% in a week and 91.8% from ATH — classic knife-catch territory without RSI/volume confirmation. DASH's 9.5% daily pop looks like a dead cat bounce at 97.2% off ATH. SOL at +4.3% unrealized is the best position in this environment — it has strong volume, weekly momentum, and is tracking toward our $115 exit target. BTC dominance at 59% is a headwind for alts broadly, but SOL has been defying that trend. No reason to add risk with subpar setups.
